recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the release-neutral GraphQL field-selection wording requested by FHIR-25408, and no follow-up is indicated from the searched issue/community evidence.
issue_request: FHIR-25408 was a Published FHIR-core change request with Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked that the GraphQL Field Selection section stop carrying explicit R3 release references in text and examples, with final disposition requiring a release-aware test-server variable instead of hard-coded test.fhir.org URLs.
initial_application: Git commit 8c3c5be2487c884c03c5a7fa079df00fbb7b142b applied the URL portion of the issue by replacing hard-coded test.fhir.org/r3 and test.fhir.org/r5 GraphQL example URLs in source/graphql.html with <%test-server%>. It left the adjacent prose label "(r3)" in the Field Selection introduction.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists graphql.html as the active GraphQL page, confirming source/graphql.html is current build source. Current source/graphql.html already used <%test-server%> for GraphQL example URLs, and related Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no broader or conflicting final decision.
reconciliation: Edited source/graphql.html to remove the stale "(r3)" wording and make the Patient example introduction release-neutral, without changing GraphQL semantics or the already-correct example URLs.
